programs.name: 2-Step Bright
programs.drawdown_type: static (8% of initial balance, does not trail)
programs.consistency_rule: none (help center: 'we do not currently enforce a consistency rule')
programs.profit_split: 80% by default; 90% with the paid 90% Profit Split add-on; 90% after the 1st Scaling Plan scale-up and 100% from the 3rd scale-up
programs.payout_frequency: first request 30 days after the first trade on the Funded Account, then every 14 days; weekly (every 7 days) with a paid add-on. Requests processed by finance within 1 day ('24-Hour Guaranteed Payouts')
programs.payout_rules_note: No minimum payout (any positive amount). All trades and pending orders must be closed before requesting. Paid in EUR by bank transfer or USDC (ERC-20). 15% Evaluation Profit Reward: 15% of Phase 1 + Phase 2 profit is added to the starting balance of a new Funded Account after reaching 10% growth and a payout (paid challenges only). Scaling Plan: +30% account size every 4 months if profitable in 2 of 4 months, at least 10% total profit and 2 payouts in the period; no stated cap.
programs.notes: Targets: Phase 1 8% ($4,000), Phase 2 5% ($2,500). Daily loss is 4% of the original account size, measured from the higher of balance or equity at the daily rollover (23:30-23:59 CET). Min 5 trading days per phase (a day counts if a trade stays open 60+ seconds); a paid add-on removes the minimum days. No time limit. Inactivity: an account is deactivated if no trade is placed for 30 days. List price €277; €207.75 with the 25% DOUBLE25 offer (seen 2026-10-19). One-time fee; no activation fee is mentioned in the official fee article. Fee refund only with a paid '100% Challenge Fee Refund' add-on (conditions not published).

programs.name: 2-Step Classic
programs.drawdown_type: static (10% of initial balance, does not trail)
programs.profit_split: 80% by default; 90% with the paid add-on; 90% after the 1st scale-up and 100% from the 3rd scale-up
programs.payout_frequency: first request 30 days after the first funded trade, then every 14 days; weekly with a paid add-on; processed within 1 day
programs.payout_rules_note: Same payout rules as 2-Step Bright: no minimum, all positions closed before requesting, bank transfer (EUR) or USDC (ERC-20), 15% Evaluation Profit Reward, Scaling Plan +30% every 4 months.
programs.notes: Targets: Phase 1 10% ($5,000), Phase 2 5% ($2,500). Daily loss is 5% of the original account size, measured from the higher of balance or equity at rollover. Min 5 trading days per phase. No time limit. List price €297; €222.75 with DOUBLE25 (seen 2026-10-19).

programs.name: 1-Step
programs.drawdown_type: intraday trailing on equity (6%, follows the equity high-water mark in real time; locks at the initial balance once equity is 6% above it)
programs.profit_split: 80% by default; 90% with the paid add-on; 90% after the 1st scale-up and 100% from the 3rd scale-up
programs.payout_frequency: first request 30 days after the first funded trade, then every 14 days; weekly with a paid add-on; processed within 1 day
programs.payout_rules_note: Same payout rules as the 2-Step plans. The 15% Evaluation Profit Reward is based on the single phase's profit.
programs.notes: Target 10% ($5,000). Daily loss 3% of the original account size, measured from the higher of balance or equity at rollover. Min 5 trading days. No time limit. List price €297; €222.75 with DOUBLE25 (seen 2026-10-19).

news_trading: Restricted on Funded accounts only: no order executions (market, limit, SL/TP, stop orders) from 5 minutes before to 5 minutes after significant news on the affected instruments. Profits from trades executed in the window are deducted (soft breach, account not failed); take profits on trades held 48+ hours are exempt. No news restriction in Phase 1/Phase 2
ea_bots_allowed: Allowed within the rules, but not on DXtrade (no API/automated trading there). Prohibited: HFT, tick scalping, grid trading, arbitrage, and bots/AI that trade at 'superhuman' speed or exploit platform delays
copy_trading: Restricted: allowed only between accounts owned by the same person (BrightFunded, other evaluation firms or retail brokers); copying between different people (incl. family/friends), account management for others and trading community signals are prohibited
overnight_weekend_holding: Allowed (overnight and weekend); swap fees apply unless the Swap-Free add-on is bought
restricted_countries_note: Serbia: NOT on the restricted list (checked 2026-10-19). Not served: residents and nationals of Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Vietnam and Pakistan (existing Pakistani accounts may continue). US and UAE residents cannot use MT5; US residents also cannot use cTrader, so US traders are limited to DXtrade. https://help.brightfunded.com/en/articles/9286630-what-countries-are-restricted-at-brightfunded

current_public_promo.applies_to: All challenge plans, per the banner on BrightFunded's site

affiliate_program.commission: Bronze 10%, Silver 12.5% (€1,000 commission in a month), Gold 15% (€2,000 commission in a month) of every challenge purchase, including repeat purchases
affiliate_program.notes: Serbia: residents of Serbia CAN join (Serbia is not on the affiliate restricted list, which covers Belarus, Cuba, Iran, Myanmar, North Korea, Russia, Sudan, Syria, the occupied Ukrainian regions and Vietnam; https://help.brightfunded.com/en/articles/9662025-who-can-become-a-brightfunded-affiliate). Must be 18+, pass KYC and sign the Affiliate Contract. Apply from the Trader Dashboard. Affiliates get a 10% discount code and a referral link (session-based tracking). Tier changes on the 1st of the month; missing a tier threshold drops you one level. Minimum payout €50; requests by 12:00 CET on the 15th, paid 15th-17th. Own code may not be used for own purchases.

recent_changes_2026.change: 15% Evaluation Profit Reward introduced: 15% of evaluation profit added to a new Funded Account after 10% funded growth and a payout (paid challenges only)

'BrightFunded 2.0': new 2-Step Bright (8%/5%, 4% daily, 8% static), 2-Step Classic (10%/5%, 5% daily, 10% static) and 1-Step (10%, 3% daily, 6% trailing) plans. Accounts bought before keep the Original 2-Step rules (8%/5%, 5% daily, 10% static)
Free $1K Challenge (F1KC) offered: free 1-phase evaluation with 1-Step rules, 80% split, no 15% profit reward (help article dated 2026-08-26; launch date not stated)

pros: Static max loss on both 2-Step plans (8% Bright, 10% Classic) and no consistency rule
No time limit and no news restriction during the evaluation phases
Fast processing: payouts processed within 1 day, no minimum payout amount
Scaling Plan of +30% every 4 months with no stated cap, and 100% split from the 3rd scale-up
Serbia is not restricted, for trading or for the affiliate program
cons: Trustpilot shows a warning: rating unavailable due to a breach of guidelines, and fake reviews were removed
Default split is 80%; 90% needs a paid add-on or a scale-up
First payout only 30 days after the first funded trade, then every 14 days unless a weekly add-on is bought
1-Step uses an intraday trailing 6% max loss with a 3% daily limit
30-day inactivity rule deactivates accounts; US traders are limited to DXtrade (no MT5/cTrader)
best_for: Forex/CFD traders outside the restricted countries who want a static-drawdown 2-step evaluation with no time limit and no consistency rule, and who are fine with an 80% default split.
